_notes: A manual theme for ScanRuler's assembly-manual. Import it in the Assembly workspace (Import theme…) or with asm.theme { action: 'import', file }.
id: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, not one of the shipped themes (workshop, picture, technical, shopfloor, brick).

look: colours as #rrggbb; fonts as CSS font lists (the reader's own fonts: the saved HTML carries none); size 10-28 px; balloon outline|filled; badge box|big|plain; sheetColour: whether the PDF pages carry the accent.
layout (optional): layout one|two|grid4|grid6|auto, words show|hide, partsBox side|corner, hardwarePage true|false.

css (optional): added to the saved HTML after the theme. Classes to aim at: .sheet (a page), .step, .step header .num (the step number), .step header .what, figure, aside.side, ul.parts, .balloon, ol.do (the instructions), .z535 (safety messages), .note, .torque, .hardware, table (bill of materials). @import, url() to files or addresses and anything that runs are taken out.
name: Garage green
about: Dark green accent, condensed headings, a tinted page, steps two a page.
